list._comment_prison: prison furniture (Docs/Prison/Plan_PrisonRework.md): tag 'prison' = prison bed. A normal bed while nobody is held in it, a cell while a prisoner is (Manageable prison cells). Does not make the room a jail - that is furniture_marker_prison.
list._comment_occupancy: a cell: a room divider entered and left explicitly (its commands are used from inside) that does not block visibility - seen through the bars. Someone locked in it reaches nothing outside (FurnitureOccupancyUtility.ValidateLockedScope)
